snippet.title: Quake - The Immortal Lock
snippet.description:
Download: https://www.slipseer.com/index.php?resources/the-immortal-lock.371/

You are Ranger, an operator of the UTJR stationed at a secret, multinational research facility in Finland. You are being deployed to investigate the disappearance of a survey team that went missing beyond the slipgate, cast into the farthest reaches of existence. Yet through the thin veil of reality, you find only a desolate plane of flesh and despair, and a dread voice that beckons your name.

This custom map for Quake 1 includes a story, extremely challenging fights, trick jumping, and a vast amount of large secret areas, but is difficulty scaled to accommodate everyone. This map is larger than an entire episode, if played in its entirety, and is best experienced in segments. There is also a start map. Please play one difficulty lower than you normally would; hard and nightmare are intended to be impossible for the majority of players. Runs on the Quoth mod, which is included. Ingame music provided by Atrium Carceri and the artists at Cryo Chamber. Trailer music is Nightmare (Ranger) by Markie Music.

This currently requires the newest version of vkQuake! 1.31.0+. Modern hardware and an SSD is also strongly recommended.
https://github.com/Novum/vkQuake/releases

To play this, put the "immortal" folder in your Quake directory, launch the game, open the console with "~", type "game immortal", and then just start a new game to load the start map.
